_comment: Only partly implemented, and said so rather than left looking complete. The card is "you MAY banish a card with 1{p} from EACH hero's graveyard. If you do, this gets +1{p}, then repeat this process." Still missing: BANISH resolves one player, so "each hero's graveyard" banishes only the controller's; the banish is not optional, so the +1{p} is unconditional instead of riding an "if you do"; and the repeat has no representation. Fixed here: the {p} filter was authored as power:1, a key CARD_IN_ZONE did not read, so "a card with 1{p}" was no filter at all -- it asked only whether the graveyard was non-empty. Also removed an INJECT_TRIGGER holding a bare trigger NAME and no effects, which was the 'repeat this process' clause: it compiled to a trigger that injects nothing, so it did not implement the repeat and cannot be mistaken for it.
